scope: Existing small marine animals and invertebrates. Fish-shaped miniatures remain owned by Passes 017-018; coral, sponge and plant identities remain owned by Passes 021-022.

migration.procedural: Wild and aquarium contexts call the same named geometry factories. Pass 020 reduces redundant crab, lobster and urchin surface density while preserving bounds, palette regions and one-draw merged topology.
migration.rareLibraries: Existing rare GLBs remain the single canonical source for wild, card and aquarium contexts; no duplicate models are introduced.
migration.contact: Each identity has an explicit substrate, shelter, perch, hover or pelagic contract. Size-normalized bottom models align their lowest authored point to the navigation half-height.
migration.animation: Existing deterministic habitat controllers remain authoritative for gliding, stepping, crawling, pulsing, drifting and swaying. Pause and reduced-motion behavior is unchanged.
